name: Lucia Caminos
summary: One of the two playable protagonists. Fresh out of prison and determined to change the odds in her favor, Lucia's story runs through the whole of Leonida.

name: Jason Duval
summary: The second playable protagonist. Jason wants an easy life, but things have a way of getting complicated — especially after he meets Lucia.

name: Cal Hampton
summary: Jason's friend and a conspiracy-minded shut-in who feels safest behind a screen, monitoring Coast Guard chatter with a beer in hand.

name: Boobie Ike
summary: A Vice City legend who turned his rap-game success into a business empire spanning a strip club, a recording studio, and more.

name: Raul Bautista
summary: A seasoned bank robber always on the lookout for talent willing to take on high-stakes, high-reward jobs.

name: Brian Heder
summary: A classic Keys drug runner from the cigarette-boat era, still moving product through the Leonida Keys with his third wife Lori.
